protocol.objective: Find any primary source that reports the same bounded empirical comparison: ONCAE-SEFIN or equivalent procurement-payment linkage, exact code plus supplier baseline, object/document challenger, false-promotion safety, supported-payment recovery, one-to-many cardinality, abstention, and reproducible sealed evaluation.
protocol.inclusion: Primary scholarly papers, official standards/reports, public technical implementations, and patents that cover at least one material component or the exact combined claim.
protocol.exclusion: Marketing pages without technical evidence, generic procurement analytics without payment attribution, and secondary summaries when a primary source was available.
protocol.deduplication: DOI, arXiv identifier, patent number, or canonical official URL.
protocol.saturation_rule: Stop after a second semantically reformulated multi-index search yields no source matching all exact-claim dimensions.

component_disposition.remaining_original_candidate: The domain-bounded empirical result that, on the independently sealed Honduras ONCAE-SEFIN Stage 4 cohort, documentary policy v3 reduced unsupported CONTRACTOR_PAYMENT promotions from 20 to 0 while preserving 58/58 supported payments, and a clean reconstruction reproduced the cohort, labels, metrics and hashes.

limitations: A bounded search cannot prove universal absence of prior art.
Direct Elicit and Scite API execution was unavailable under the connected plans; the failures are recorded rather than hidden.
The claim is revocable if an earlier primary source reporting the same bounded protocol and result is later found.
Novelty attaches only to the exact empirical result, not to record linkage, reconciliation, evidence acquisition, provenance, abstention, or procurement-payment integration as general methods.
